lines.sub: Ek bottle company. $73M se $750M tak. Sirf 4 saal mein.
1913. Stanley mazdooron aur campers ke liye mazboot hare flask banata tha.
Unka ek bada tumbler tha: Quencher. Par wo bikta hi nahi tha. Company use band karne wali thi.
Phir teen auraton ke ek shopping blog, The Buy Guide, ko ye cup pasand aa gaya.
Unhone khud 5,000 cup khareede aur apne followers ko bech diye. Saare bik gaye.
Tab Stanley ko samajh aaya: uska asli customer koi aur tha.
Naye boss Terence Reilly ne pastel rang nikaale, limited drops kiye, aur auraton ko center mein rakha.
Phir ek din ek car aag mein jal gayi. Par andar rakhe Stanley cup mein barf ab bhi bachi thi.
Video viral hua. Aur Stanley ne use nayi car de di.
Sabak ye hai ki aapka asli customer shayad wo nahi, jiske liye aapne product banaya.
Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye, follow karo!
